name: ANSI/IEEE Make-before-break changeover contact form
aliases: IEEE Transfer Make Before Break Contact
summary: IEEE-library reference for make-before-break changeover contact, with its operating meaning, connection notes and public vendor block identity.
description: This reference locates make-before-break changeover contact in Autodesk's IEEE-oriented miscellaneous switches family. A make-before-break changeover contact establishes the next path before releasing the previous path during its documented transfer. The temporary overlap must be understood for the connected circuits. The public library uses HSW1SC7_F for its horizontal representation; this is a vendor block name, not an IEEE standards symbol number.

Read the operating mechanism and the contact reference state together. Cross-reference every associated contact to the same device and show which movement, signal or reset changes its condition; the symbol alone does not establish the complete switching sequence.

Identify any circuits that would be interconnected during the overlap. A break-before-make transfer opens the previous path before establishing the next. The linked functional counterpart explains the same operating role in its own drawing context; agreement of every detailed convention mark is not asserted.
